what_this_is: Where the Workshop's shared rows and tool folders are (scripts/tool-folders.mjs). Each folder is in this repository, or in an installed module when it names one. rows + rows_named: the files of rows in that folder; packages: a folder whose sub-folders are tool folders, found by name; rows_in_each_package: the file of rows each tool folder may hold. A tool folder name is found in exactly one place. A new place to read tools from is one row here.
